title: STRATO (BlockApps STRATO Mercata L1) — $16.19M DefiLlama TVL verified on a public chain; no unprivileged extraction path found

key_facts: STRATO Mercata by BlockApps; chain ID 123354377739506; solidity-on-SolidVM (eth_getCode=0x01 for contracts); 17 validators; PBFT.
DefiLlama TVL $16,190,997 (2026-10-10) = GOLDST $13.49M + USDST $2.01M + SILVST $0.21M + ETH/WBTC/USDC/etc.; reconciled against live balances (block 622,692).
CDP vault 0x...1013 holds 3,134.6331 GOLDST (≈$13.12M) against 4,564,577.74 USDST GOLDST-backed debt; totalDebtAll 4,699,119.41; CR ≈ 2.88x.
All core contracts owned by AdminRegistry 0x...100c (3 admin EOAs, 60% threshold); setLogicContract upgradeability everywhere; 143-entry function-scoped whitelist.
Oracle writes, token mints, pauses, bridge confirmations all revert for a random sender; borrow/redeem/unstake/CDP-mint without a position all revert.
caveats: Behavioral verification only — SolidVM source code is not published (explorer serves ABIs, not sources); a logic bug outside tested call paths cannot be fully excluded.
USD values point-in-time; tokenized-metal valuation (GOLDST/SILVST) relies on issuer/Mercata custody + oracle; GOLDST is largely chain-native (on-chain oracle and DefiLlama agree within ~0.4%).
Exfiltration off STRATO depends on operator-confirmed bridges or DEX exit liquidity even if value were extractable on-chain.
Governance/key risk (P): 2-of-3 admin EOAs or the whitelisted price-updater EOA compromise is the dominant tail risk; no E-U path.
one_liner: STRATO is BlockApps' public mercata L1; its $16.19M DefiLlama TVL (mostly gold-backed CDP collateral) is fully verifiable on-chain but no external-unprivileged extraction path was found ($0 E-U); the residual risk is the 2-of-3 admin EOA governance and whitelisted price-bot key.
